verdict.rationale: Stable's own marketing documents an on-request Shred action that securely destroys physical mail while keeping digital copies. It lists basic per-mail actions (scan, ship, shred, deposit), which suggests per-item disposal choices. Missing for 10: documented physical storage/retention windows, shredding confirmation or certificate, explicit per-item disposal policy controls in docs or API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, I control what happens to the physical mail — documented storage windows, on-request shredding with confirmation, and per-item disposal choices

citations.quote: Shred: Securely destroy physical mail while maintaining digital copies.
Ship: Forward anywhere in the world, discounted rates included.
